result.instructions: ZeroRun is repository-bound and fail-closed. Execution tools may run tests or create local setup state; honor their approval fields and never treat a candidate, bypass, miss, or uncertainty as reusable.

tools.description: With explicit setup approval, inspect and execute pytest collection, possibly create managed repository files and acquire a pinned runtime, then generate a non-authorizing .zerorun-pytest.candidate.json. This never activates reuse.

approve_setup.description: Must be true only after the user approves managed setup, repository-file changes, runtime acquisition, and pytest collection.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

targets.description: Optional pytest targets. Defaults to tests/, test/, testing/, then repository root.

task.description: Optional configured pytest task name. Auto-selected when exactly one direct python -m pytest task exists.

tools.name: prepare_pytest

tools.description: Run the reviewed generic pytest node adapter. It reuses only exact nodes authorized by a valid .zerorun-pytest.json profile; unknown, changed, unsupported, or racing nodes execute fresh. The pinned image must already be present and host environment forwarding is refused.

profile.description: Profile path relative to the repository root. Defaults to .zerorun-pytest.json.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: run_pytest

tools.description: Run a configured task-level ZeroRun task. Use run_pytest instead when a valid reviewed pytest profile is present. The task must be hermetic v2, environment-free, and use an already-present pinned image.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: run_tests

tools.description: Return local ZeroRun reuse counts, conservative verified time saved, observation time, and pilot metrics.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: stats

tools.description: Explain whether a configured task is currently a cache HIT, MISS, or safety BYPASS without executing it; invalid cache metadata is quarantined.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: explain

tools.description: Validate ZeroRun setup, including the reviewed pytest profile when present.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: doctor

tools.description: List configured ZeroRun tasks and their cache policy.

root.description: Repository root or any path inside the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

tools.name: list_tasks
